status: Status: frozen (ADR-0119). Assigned values are immutable; a 'reserved...' construction may be filled once.
rules: Every OM canonical struct is a CBOR map with unsigned-integer keys. A key, once assigned in a struct, is never reused for another meaning, even after the field is retired (retired keys move to 'reserved').
Top-level objects always carry key 0 (object_type), key 1 (object_version) and optionally key 23 (extensions). Object-specific keys start at 2. Nested structs start at 0 and carry no type/version.
Optional fields are ABSENT when unused. CBOR null is never a valid value of a typed field (error null_forbidden).

A key that is not listed in 'fields' (including a 'reserved' key) is an unknown critical field: the object is rejected (error unknown_field). Forward-compatible optional data goes into key 23 extensions.
'set' arrays are sorted by the bytewise order of each element's canonical encoding and contain no duplicates (error set_order).

Type grammar: {uint:[min,max|null]}, {bool:null|true|false} (true/false = constant), {bstr:[min,max]}, {tstr:[min,max]} (byte length), {enum:name}, {ref:Struct}, {array:T,n:[min,max]}, {set:T,n:[min,max]}, {union:{on:key,variants:{value:Struct}}}, {dispatch:{on:field_name,table:{value:Struct},default:'opaque_map'}}, {signed:TypeName} (bstr holding a canonical SignedEnvelope whose body is that type), {any:null}, {ext:null}.

The ASCII prefix 'om.critical.' is reserved by ADR-0157 for mandatory-to-understand extension IDs. Any unknown extension whose ID begins with that prefix is treated as critical and rejects the containing object even if ExtEntry.critical is false; non-critical registrations MUST NOT use the prefix. Existing critical om.acs.fork_ack and om.acs.legacy_policy are grandfathered because V1 already knows them.

Enum values listed in 'enum_value_waves' were added after W0 and are valid only in objects of that wave or later. A decoder validating a W0 object accepts only the enum values without a later-wave entry; in particular W0 SignedEnvelopes accept sig_role 1..6 only and publication_signing_key (7) is valid only on the W3 Publication objects whose object-type 'signed.roles' list it (ADR-0168 finding F-16).

fields.name: body
fields.note: canonical encoding of a top-level object; validated recursively

fields.name: device_credentials
fields.note: frozen set: binds DeviceID to DeviceCredential digest (ADR-0119/ADR-0135/ADR-0141)

reserved.name: policy_commitment
reserved.note: not a field: the commitment is Hash(OM-RECOVERY-POLICY-HASH-v1, body) stored in AccountControlState key 10

fields.name: signature
fields.note: for one-time kinds 3/4: composite device signature under OM-PREKEY-SIG-v1 over ADR-0140 context [1, DeviceID, CryptoProfile, bundle_generation, provider_pool_id, kind, key_id, public_key]

fields.name: generation
fields.note: signed-prekey generation; strictly monotonic per DeviceID + CryptoProfile across all provider pools (ADR-0140)

fields.name: pq_signed_prekey
fields.note: mandatory since ADR-0126 (ADR-0118 §6): validators reject a bundle without it. 'req' keeps its assigned value because assigned values are immutable; the rule is carried by keys.cddl and by om-crypto-profiles required_bundle_fields.

fields.name: provider_pool_id
fields.note: provider-distinct consumable-pool id; does not reset the signed-prekey generation namespace (ADR-0140)

reserved.name: acs_generation
reserved.note: retired before first release by ADR-0140; MUST be absent in current AsyncKeyBundle v1 and never reused

reserved.name: acs_state_hash
reserved.note: retired before first release by ADR-0140; MUST be absent in current AsyncKeyBundle v1 and never reused

reserved.name: representation
reserved.note: W4 services_bots RepresentationGrant; unknown to W0 decoders (critical)

reserved.name: foreign_provenance
reserved.note: W4 bridges ForeignProvenance; unknown to W0 decoders (critical)

reserved.name: referral_attestation
reserved.note: cannot live inside the subject-signed body; carried as a separate ReferralAttestation object

fields.name: request_key
fields.note: ADR-0126; trusted only when the ticket carries an intro_identity signature

fields.name: ciphertext
fields.note: HPKE base-mode ciphertext of a signed MessageRequestPayload; length <= ticket payload_limit_bytes + AEAD tag

fields.name: reply_route
fields.note: ADR-0146 request-scoped reply capability: one logical bootstrap response; exact retries and at most 8 distinct candidate wrappers while OPEN; no new candidate after closure

fields.name: reply_delivery_key
fields.note: ADR-0142/0144/0145/0146/0147 request-scoped acceptance-reply bootstrap key: fresh key/id per MessageRequest; crypto_profile matches request; route_binding matches exact reply_route; expires_at <= reply_route.expires_at; bootstrap acceptance deadline is min(reply_route.expires_at, reply_delivery_key.expires_at) with no independent v1 request expiry; wrapper expiry is bounded by that authenticated context; never promoted to established relationship authority

fields.name: ciphertext
fields.note: OM-Crypto-v1 exact allowed lengths are padding bucket + 16: 1040, 4112, 16400, 65552, 131088

semantic_rules: meaningful only on ConversationEvent message.create content.blocks or message.edit replacement.blocks; other event kinds ignore the non-critical presentation metadata
block_index values are strictly increasing and unique within one RichListV1Extension
referenced block must exist and be W0 paragraph
ordinal is required exactly when style=ordered and forbidden when style=unordered
first inline is unmarked InlineText beginning with ADR-0150 canonical fallback prefix for depth/style/ordinal
first annotation and first annotation after any block_index gap have depth 0; inside a contiguous run depth increase is at most +1

after registered payload schema validation, any invalid reference/order/nesting/ordinal-presence/fallback semantic check invalidates/ignores the whole non-critical rich-list interpretation; base W0 RichText remains valid

a wire-criticality mismatch rejects the containing object; any other registered object/payload-schema violation makes the whole non-critical enhancement unusable and leaves the event valid (ADR-0155, amending ADR-0149/ADR-0151); annotations never apply to another event's RichText

LanInviteRendezvousV1.note: W1 local_delivery semantics for Invite.lan_rendezvous opaque W0 bytes: bstr.cbor LanInviteRendezvousV1 (ADR-0158).

LanSignalEnvelopeV1.note: SDP/ICE credentials are encrypted under the seed-derived OM-LAN-SIGNAL-KEY-v1 with OM-LAN-SIGNAL-AAD-v1; this struct may travel via QR/manual/local signalling and carries no identity authority (ADR-0158).

LanFrameV1.note: Kind-specific required/forbidden field combinations are normatively frozen in spec/cddl/lan.cddl; frames are transport records only (ADR-0158).

fields.name: history_window_seconds
fields.note: required when history_policy is recent_window, otherwise absent

fields.name: mls_epoch_ref
fields.note: MLS epoch of the Commit that installed this state version

fields.name: acs_head_hash
fields.note: kind account_control_evidence: validated AccountControlState head naming the revoked or quarantined device

fields.name: join_ref
fields.note: admin approval of a link join request: counts one use of that invite

fields.name: seconds
fields.note: 0 turns the timer off; the resulting policy then omits disappearing_timer

fields.name: reply_to_item
fields.note: bundle-local history_item_id of an earlier item

extensions.name: om.acs.fork_ack
extensions.note: only on a fork bridge state, whose previous_state_hash is the common ancestor; authorization per ADR-0127

extensions.name: om.acs.legacy_policy
extensions.note: critical commitment: unsupported verifiers reject the containing ACS; W0 still rejects legacy_policy retirement authorization; activation remains W1/off by default

extensions.name: om.voice-note.v1
extensions.note: non-critical V1 presentation metadata; object/criticality/schema are registry-bound; attachment_index refers to the immutable message.create attachment list; ADR-0155: meaningful only on message.create; schema failures ignore the extension, never the event

extensions.name: om.location-card.v1
extensions.note: non-critical one-shot static point; signed E7 coordinates use unsigned offsets; RichText must carry the exact canonical geo: fallback token per ADR-0149; ADR-0155: meaningful only on message.create, fallback must name exactly one canonical point, card suppressed once an edit's materialized text fails the token check

extensions.name: om.rich-list.v1
extensions.note: non-critical V1 list presentation over existing paragraph blocks; a wire-criticality mismatch rejects the containing object, while registered-schema violations and reference/nesting/fallback semantic failures ignore the whole enhancement (ADR-0155); annotations bind only to the carrying event's RichText; no W0 RichText block-type change
